note: NOT BANKED. Revision 2 of a maximum 2 under A3-STAGE1-PREREGISTERED.md. A third failure triggers §6 — reduce Choose a Response in the Listening blueprint.
whatChanged: cr-v3 kept the near-miss method for distractors but held the STIMULUS constant: every spoken line was two-part mildly bad news. So near-miss replies were systematically relief or disbelief and the key was systematically rueful acceptance, and all three solvers found that in one pass (+52.8). Here the near-miss method is unchanged and the STIMULUS varies: good news, a request, a question to the listener, an offer, neutral information, a correction, a constraint, an invitation, a complaint, a suggestion, an apology, an announcement. The key is accordingly relieved, accepting, factual, advisory or neutral about as often as it is rueful — 'the inconvenienced reply' should now be a losing heuristic, and on several items it is a DISTRACTOR.
